title: notes-request
description: Body of POST /sessions/{id}/notes: exactly {"noticeVersion": "<id>"} (NAS-05, additive before the first consumer; the earlier {} body is refused). noticeVersion is the id of the DRAFT notice the student saw before pressing (what is sent, to whom, retention, Delete cannot recall it); the wording and the version label are placeholders owned by counsel and the Product Owner (G1). The server only accepts ids it knows (400 validation_failed otherwise) and stores the id with the press and in the content-free notes.requested audit row. The Idempotency-Key header is required.

noticeVersion.description: Opaque notice id, same shape as the syllabus noticeVersion: 1 to 64 of [A-Za-z0-9._-], no trailing newline. Current draft placeholder: notes-notice-draft-1.
